title: Lipid and iron parameter-attribution audit

scope.mode: Read-only frozen-source/model audit plus new report files only
scope.numeric_outputs: Existing aggregate and deterministic summaries only; arithmetic/formulas interpreted from frozen code.

claim_checks.claim: L03 implies residual r~.132, TC slope~10.87 and HDL slope~-2.11.
claim_checks.qualification: These are model-population estimands under reported inputs plus author assumptions; not reported source estimates or exact finite generated averages.

claim_checks.claim: All source/generated/reference differences are transfer failures.
claim_checks.qualification: Source statistics use different operators; author construction and conditioning assumptions intervene before a requested estimand exists. Finite generated draws add simulation variation; measured reference adds sampling/selection uncertainty. A broad definition of transfer can label all bridges but does not identify their causes.

claim_checks.claim: These examples show a faithful evidence compiler.
claim_checks.qualification: Selected source values/types and declarations are implemented faithfully. The complete joint distributions are not uniquely implied by those sources; model-law agreement cannot establish scientific optimality or target validity.

claim_checks.claim: Iron A has no independent structural contribution beyond direct source transfer.
claim_checks.qualification: Its assumed2/3 depletion weight changes margins;20% independent Hb redraw preserves those margins but changes threshold OR/joint prevalence and attenuates rank dependence. B has no such redraw.

claim_checks.claim: The ranges approximately.11-.14,10.0-11.3,and-2.0to-2.2 are L03 seed ranges.
claim_checks.qualification: They are rounded ranges of L01-L03 author means, not L03 seed ranges.

operator_separation.source: Reported marginal moments, geometric means, pooled ranks and joint threshold counts, with their original populations/operators.
operator_separation.declaration: Reported constants plus derived transformations and assumptions about joint law, conditioning, composition, measurement and transport.
operator_separation.model_implication: Requested analysis applied to the population distribution defined by that complete law.
operator_separation.generated_aggregate: Requested analysis applied to three finite sampled tables; no identity with model-population value is required.
operator_separation.reference: Requested analysis applied to a measured selected sample with its weights/uncertainty; descriptive comparator, not a parameter source.

numeric_provenance.copy_scope: Q5 L01-L03 and iron A/B analyses only; no earlier-wave generator audit claimed.
numeric_provenance.existing_summary_limit: Existing audit summaries were reused, not independently recomputed from rows.
